items.criterion: An uploaded image exists in the bucket at the key derived from its own bytes.
items.judgment: Upload an image as an author and read the object store at the digest key.

items.criterion: A draft page's object is refused to a signed-out caller.
items.judgment: Upload to a draft page and request the object with no session.

items.criterion: Publishing makes the same object readable at the same key.
items.judgment: Publish the page and repeat the request that was refused.

items.criterion: A draft page's route answers not-found to a signed-out visitor.
items.judgment: Request the draft page's address with no session.

items.criterion: The sitemap names every published route and no draft.
items.judgment: Read the sitemap and look for the draft slug.

items.criterion: Identical bytes uploaded twice leave one media row.
items.judgment: Upload the same bytes twice and count the media rows at that key.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous publishes leave exactly one published page.
items.judgment: Publish one page twice at once and count the page rows.

items.criterion: Block positions stay contiguous from one after a removal.
items.judgment: Add three blocks, remove the middle one, and read the positions.

items.criterion: A reader session is denied every studio endpoint.
items.judgment: Call the studio endpoints from a reader session.

items.criterion: One author is denied another author's draft media.
items.judgment: Request the other author's draft object from the first author's session.

items.criterion: The default listing opens on the nine seeded notebooks in star order.
items.judgment: Read the listing with no sort and compare the leading slugs.

items.criterion: The listing pages at thirty with no notebook repeated across pages.
items.judgment: Read both listing pages and compare their contents.

items.criterion: A signup creates one free reader account for an address.
items.judgment: Submit the email method and read the reader rows.

items.criterion: A submission filling the unattended decoy field creates no reader.
items.judgment: Submit the sign-up form with the decoy field filled.

items.criterion: No public document carries a credential.
items.judgment: Read each public route's document and search for the credential markers.
